summary: postinstall installs undeclared sibling package randompkgb at install time
details: randompkga@1.0.4 ships only a package.json with no source code (declared main index.js is absent) and defines a postinstall hook that shells out to install a separate npm package, randompkgb, which is not listed in dependencies. On `npm install randompkga`, the postinstall runs `rnpm i randompkgb`, fetching and executing an undeclared sibling package (and its own lifecycle scripts) at install time. This routes the actual payload outside the manifest's dependency tree, so lockfiles, `npm audit`, and dependency-graph reviewers do not see it. Manifest metadata is also empty/placeholder (empty description, empty author, no keywords), consistent with lure/loader scaffolding rather than a normal library release.
